raw: anaerobe (but growth under aerobic conditions possible)

notes: An aerotolerant organism is still an anaerobe.

DOMINANT: facultative metabolism is a capability, so a strain grown only aerobically is recorded as "aerobe" and one grown only anaerobically as "anaerobe" -- neither negates the capability. Majority voting therefore called Citrobacter freundii (13 aerobe vs 3 facultative), Enterobacter cloacae (8 vs 7) and Serratia marcescens (23 vs 18) aerobes, though all three are Enterobacteriaceae and obligately facultative. Any report of facultative growth wins.
Synonym of facultative anaerobe in BacDive usage.
